critical_code_review_comments: Vendors.jsx uses ISO string comparison for promo start/end date filtering (p.end_date < nowIso). Works for well-formed UTC ISO strings but fragile if dates are stored with mixed timezones/precision — consider Date.parse() comparison.

catOf() classifier is case-insensitive but tag matching uses includes('skin') which correctly matches 'Skin Care'; supplements/clothes require exact lowercase equality. This is intentional but could miss 'Supplement' (singular) or 'Clothing' variants.

VendorRow copyCode uses navigator.clipboard.writeText without await on the Promise; toast fires optimistically even if the write fails on unsupported browsers (catch still fires for sync throw only). Minor.
